overview: The Medford City Council reviewed a comprehensive parking policy report and referred it to a Committee of the Whole. The Council also approved several local resolutions regarding state roadway cleanup, vendor data breach notifications, trash ordinance reviews, and Community Preservation Act funding.

items.title: Common Victualler License for Dunkin' Donuts
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Greater Boston Donuts LLC at 283 Mystic Avenue with standard operating hour restrictions.

items.title: Parking Policy and Enforcement Report Update
items.summary: Referred a comprehensive 60-page parking policy update to a Committee of the Whole to review its recommendations alongside administration officials.

items.title: Online Posting of Traffic Commission Rules
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the city administration post all Medford Traffic Commission rules and regulations on the city website.

items.title: ParkMobile Cybersecurity Breach Notification
items.summary: Approved consolidated resolutions requesting that Park Medford directly notify local users affected by a recent ParkMobile data security incident.

items.title: Tufts Park Memorial Bricks Application and CPA Funding
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the Parks Commission to reopen applications for memorial bricks at the Gone Too Soon Memorial and investigate CPA funding eligibility.

items.title: Citywide Trash Collection and Ordinance Review
items.summary: Referred solid waste rules to the administration for markup and requested public informational notices regarding receptacle placement times.

items.title: Congratulating Medford Youth Hockey President
items.summary: Approved a resolution extending congratulations to former Councilor Paul Camuso on his election as president of Medford Youth Hockey.

items.title: State Roadway Debris Cleanup Request
items.summary: Approved an expanded resolution asking MassDOT and DCR to clean roadside trash and dead trees along state routes and highway ramps.

items.title: Rooftop Graffiti Removal at 28 Main Street
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the owner of 28 Main Street to remove rooftop graffiti, suggesting possible city or Historical Commission assistance.

items.title: CPA Appropriation for Historic Church Door Restoration
items.summary: Approved a $5,000 Community Preservation Act appropriation to restore an historic door at the Unitarian Universalist Church.

items.title: Condolences for Robert McGovern and Thomas Cangiano
items.summary: Approved resolutions holding moments of silence and dedicating the meeting to the memory of community volunteers Robert McGovern and Thomas Cangiano.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: Approved a committee report on CDBG funds and tabled a report regarding city staff positions to the next meeting.

items.title: Public Participation on Water Meters and Parking Procedures
items.summary: Heard public remarks regarding the lifespan and battery replacement of city water meters, followed by a resident question on public input at upcoming parking meetings.
